title: Crowd Rush 3D
description: Lead a growing 3D squad down sky-high obstacle tracks, choosing the highest multiplier gates to storm rival forces and smash the fortress.
controls: Drag left and right to steer your crowd through multiplier gates, dodge traps, and overwhelm enemy squads.

zh-CN.title: 兄弟跟我冲
zh-CN.description: 超爽 3D 人海冲锋跑酷：左右滑动挑选最大倍率增益门，避开旋转机关，带着满屏小弟一路推平终极城堡。
zh-CN.controls: 按住屏幕左右滑动控制队伍走位，穿过倍率门扩充人数并冲垮沿途守军。
